prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a game-ready pixel-art sprite sheet for Shovey, a calm top-down garden puzzle game. Create ONE small friendly garden duck in FOUR separately drawn cardinal views on an exactly even 2 by 2 sprite sheet: top-left LEFT, top-right UP (back view), bottom-left RIGHT, bottom-right DOWN (front view). Each view centered in its own equal square with generous transparent margins, identical scale and the same duck design. True overhead three-quarter game view, cream white round body, small warm brown wing patch, short broad orange bill, dark clear eyes, tiny orange feet. Each facing must be redrawn anatomically for that direction: head and face readable, body upright, proper front, back and side views; not four rotated copies. Crisp simple low-resolution pixel art, deliberately large pixels as if each duck occupies about 24 by 26 pixels in a 32 by 32 game cell, a limited 10-color palette with clean light and shadow, dark brown soft outline, no noisy feathers, no gradients or blur. Must be recognizable as a duck at tiny icon size. No movement animation, no extra ducks or chicks, no scenery, floor, tile, cast shadow, frame, labels, lettering or watermark. Entire background is true transparent alpha. Four sprites only, no objects crossing cell boundaries.
fitting: Four equal sheet cells; ignore alpha below 128 for clean bounds; common scale to 27 pixels; nearest-neighbor resize onto transparent 32 by 32 canvases with feet aligned.
